title: Choose the visual world for /jobs
question: Safer hand: three familiar grounded worlds, plus the category standard played against Handshake, Simplify, and LinkedIn. The dice are suspended this round — you pick. /jobs stays scan-and-act.

options.label: Career Fair Aisle
options.lineage: university career-fair booth rows and table tents
options.thesis: The market is an aisle of booths: walk, stop, take a flyer, or keep moving.
options.viewport: A horizontal aisle of company booths as listing rows. Logo on a tent card, title on the handout, Apply is TAKE FLYER spanning the booth height, Mark applied / Can't fit / Save as table-edge stamps.
options.risk: Reads as event branding if the aisle is decorative instead of a dense walkable market.

options.label: Help-Wanted
options.thesis: Internships run as classifieds: dense columns you circle, X out, or clip.
options.viewport: Full-bleed newsprint. Tight columns of company + role + location. Right edge of each ad: CIRCLE Apply, CHECK Mark applied, X Can't fit, CLIP Save, all the height of the ad.
options.risk: Nostalgia costume if the type is not actually the density of a classified page.

options.label: Sorting Case
options.thesis: Every role is a slot. You sort it: Apply, Applied, Can't fit, or Hold.
options.viewport: A wall of labeled slots. Each intern listing is a slip in a cell; the four actions are the four columns you sort into, full height of the slip.
options.risk: Cute furniture if the grid is a picture of boxes rather than the actual sort.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Handshake, Simplify, and LinkedIn intern boards, played straight: sidebar, filters, cards, primary Apply — at their craft level, not a parody.
canonCard.viewport: Left nav, top search, filter chips, featured card, then internships with Apply on the right — the arrangement those three products already taught.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Handshake, Simplify, and LinkedIn by design.
